name: lldpStatsTxPortTable
description: A table containing LLDP transmission statistics for individual ports. Entries are not required to exist in this table while the lldpPortConfigEntry object is equal to 'disabled(4)'.

.1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.2.6.1.1.name: lldpStatsTxPortNum
.1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.2.6.1.1.description: The index value used to identify the port component (contained in the local chassis with the LLDP agent) associated with this entry. The value of this object is used as a port index to the lldpStatsTable.

.1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.2.6.1.2.name: lldpStatsTxPortFramesTotal
.1.0.8802.1.1.2.1.2.6.1.2.description: The number of LLDP frames transmitted by this LLDP agent on the indicated port.
